en_title: Mass Effect 5 Dev Says BioWare Saw What Larian and CD Projekt Had Done in the RPG Space and Was Taking the Franchise to ‘The Next Level’
cn_title: 前开发者称《质量效应5》曾力求突破
subtitle: 曾有多大野心
opus_summary: 《质量效应5》前开发者透露，BioWare曾参考拉瑞安与CD Projekt的RPG作品，力求在忠于原三部曲的同时提升系列表现。EA随后宣布取消项目并关闭BioWare，约50名开发者因此受到影响。

paragraphs.en: A former Mass Effect 5 developer has said that BioWare had seen what RPG powerhouses Larian and CD Projekt were achieving with their games, and was responding by taking Mass Effect to “the next level.”
paragraphs.cn: 一名前《质量效应5》开发者表示，BioWare曾注意到拉瑞安和CD Projekt凭借各自作品取得的成就，并试图在忠于原三部曲的基础上，将《质量效应》系列提升到「下一个高度」。

paragraphs.en: Yesterday, EA sent shockwaves through the industry with the announcement that the next Mass Effect game was canceled and its developer, BioWare, was shutting down . Around 50 people were reportedly working on the game before development ended.
paragraphs.cn: 昨日，EA宣布取消下一部《质量效应》游戏，并关闭其开发商BioWare，在业界引发震动。据称，该作在开发结束前约有50人参与制作。

paragraphs.en: Since yesterday’s dramatic news, a number of people who had worked on Mass Effect 5 talked in vague terms about the game it was shaping up to be . On X / Twitter, New York Times bestselling author Catherynne M. Valente responded to a user who said, “A game industry that cannot figure out how to make a sequel to the literal best game of all time is a game industry that is fundamentally broken,” with: “We did figure it out. We were working on a great game. Just saying.”
paragraphs.cn: 在昨日的戏剧性消息传出后，多名曾参与《质量效应5》开发的人员都以含蓄的方式谈到了这款游戏原本将呈现的样貌。纽约时报畅销书作者Catherynne M. Valente在X上回应一名用户时写道：「一个连如何制作出史上最好的游戏续作都想不明白的游戏行业，根本就是出了问题的游戏行业。」她回复道：「我们确实想明白了。我们当时正在制作一款很棒的游戏。仅此而已。」

paragraphs.en: One person who was laid off from BioWare, cinematic supervisor Tony de Waal, took to LinkedIn to say Mass Effect 5 would have been “something special,” offering players “a level of autonomy and choice that no other game has been able to match.”
paragraphs.cn: BioWare的一名前员工、曾担任电影场景监督的Tony de Waal遭到裁员。他在LinkedIn上表示，《质量效应5》原本会是「一款特别的作品」，能为玩家提供「其他游戏都无法匹敌的自主权和选择空间」。

paragraphs.en: “We saw what Larian and CD Projekt were bringing to the table with their latest offerings, and started down a path to bring Mass Effect to the next level while remaining true to the Trilogy,” he continued.
paragraphs.cn: 他继续说道：「我们看到了拉瑞安和CD Projekt在最新作品中展现的成果，于是开始探索一条道路，希望在忠于三部曲的同时，将《质量效应》提升到下一个高度。」

paragraphs.en: “I'm sad you won't ever get to see what we were cooking, and sad for the small, talented group of devs who were all punching above their weight to make something special. Please consider those who stayed with BioWare until the very end. They are truly some of the most talented people I've had the pleasure of working with throughout my career.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我很遗憾你们永远无法看到我们当时正在筹备的作品，也为那群才华横溢的开发者感到难过。他们都在竭尽所能，努力做出一款特别的作品。请大家也想想那些一直留在BioWare、直到最后一刻的员工。他们确实是我职业生涯中有幸共事过的最优秀人才之一。」

paragraphs.en: Both Larian and CD Projekt have enjoyed enormous success with their RPGs over the last decade, while BioWare struggled with a series of disappointing releases that failed to meet EA’s expectations. After the franchise-best sales of Dragon Age: Inquisition, BioWare sought live-service success with Anthem, then spent the best part of a decade on the troubled Dragon Age: The Veilguard. Both underperformed. Mass Effect, meanwhile, has seen mixed success. Mass Effect Andromeda is widely considered a disappointment among fans, though the series' more recent Legendary Edition remaster was well-received.
paragraphs.cn: 过去十年间，拉瑞安和CD Projekt凭借旗下RPG取得了巨大成功；与此同时，BioWare却接连推出表现令人失望、未能达到EA预期的作品。在《龙腾世纪：审判》创下系列最佳销量后，BioWare试图通过《圣歌》取得服务型游戏的成功，随后又耗费近十年时间制作陷入困境的《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》。这两款作品都没有达到预期。与此同时，《质量效应》系列的表现也好坏参半。《质量效应：仙女座》普遍被粉丝视为令人失望的作品，不过，该系列后来推出的《质量效应：传奇版》重制版则广受好评。

paragraphs.en: BioWare had spent the past half a decade teasing the next Mass Effect's setting and story. We'd had it confirmed that Mass Effect 5 would have been set hundreds of years after Mass Effect 3 , and feature a narrative that re-centers the action on the franchise's original Milky Way setting, long after the Reapers were defeated.
paragraphs.cn: 过去五年里，BioWare一直在陆续透露下一部《质量效应》的背景设定和故事。我们已经确认，《质量效应5》的故事原本将发生在《质量效应3》之后数百年，并重新将叙事焦点放回系列最初设定的银河系；那时，收割者早已被击败。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, CD Projekt has released The Witcher 3, which is considered by some to be the greatest fantasy RPG of all time, Cyberpunk 2077, which after a disastrous launch is now considered one of the best sci-fi RPGs ever made, and is set to follow both up with various sequels that are among the most-anticipated video games on earth.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，CD Projekt先后推出了《巫师3》——有人认为它是有史以来最伟大的奇幻RPG——以及《赛博朋克2077》。后者经历灾难性的发售后，如今已被视为有史以来最出色的科幻RPG之一。接下来，CD Projekt还将通过多部续作延续这两大系列，而这些作品都跻身全球最受期待的电子游戏之列。

paragraphs.en: Larian saw critical and commercial acclaim with its Divinity: Original Sin games, but 2023’s Baldur’s Gate 3 propelled the studio into the stratosphere, selling millions of copies and resetting expectations around what a role-playing game could be.
paragraphs.cn: 拉瑞安凭借《神界：原罪》系列赢得了评论界和商业上的认可，但2023年的《博德之门3》让这家工作室一飞冲天。该作销量达到数百万份，也重新定义了人们对RPG可能实现的高度。

paragraphs.en: It’s hard to say what Mass Effect 5 might have been, but based on comments from former developers, it was being made with the likes of The Witcher 3, Cyberpunk, and Baldur’s Gate 3 in mind. The line about “a level of autonomy and choice that no other game has been able to match,” is quite the claim, but to me is clearly in reaction to the likes of Baldur’s Gate 3, which reacts to player choice and experimentation in a way that goes above and beyond most games ever released.
paragraphs.cn: 很难断言《质量效应5》原本会是什么样子，但根据前开发者的说法，这款游戏的制作参考了《巫师3》、《赛博朋克2077》和《博德之门3》等作品。「达到其他游戏都无法企及的自主权与选择程度」这句话无疑是个颇大胆的说法，但在我看来，它显然是在回应《博德之门3》这类作品。后者会根据玩家的选择和尝试作出反应，其表现远超绝大多数已经推出的游戏。

paragraphs.en: We have much more on the dramatic news of BioWare's closure, including reaction from fans and the video game industry , IGN's Ryan McCaffrey on why BioWare was the greatest RPG developer ever , and the thoughts of one former BioWare developer on the possibility of Dragon Age and Mass Effect living on .
paragraphs.cn: 关于BioWare关闭这一戏剧性消息，我们还带来了更多报道，包括粉丝和电子游戏行业的反应、IGN的Ryan McCaffrey对BioWare为何曾是最伟大RPG开发商的分析，以及一名前BioWare开发者对于《龙腾世纪》和《质量效应》系列能否延续下去的看法。
